cmd:
free -h | head -2; python3 --version; ffmpeg -version | head -1
curl -s -H "Authorization: token $(cat /etc/vps-github-bridge/token)" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/scripts/tts_samples.py?ref=main" -o /tmp/tts_samples.py
wc -l /tmp/tts_samples.py
nohup bash -c 'python3 -m venv --system-site-packages /opt/silero-venv && /opt/silero-venv/bin/pip install -q torch numpy && cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo && /opt/silero-venv/bin/python /tmp/tts_samples.py' > /tmp/tts_samples.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3; echo started; tail -3 /tmp/tts_samples.log
